intelligence.human_view: Think of a house where every door opens the same way. You walk in and the host greets you warmly — then steps aside, and you are simply in the room, nothing explaining itself. The lights are real lamps you could touch, not pictures of lamps. The colors on the walls are ones you can tell apart at a glance, not two purples pretending to be different. The little row of buttons at the bottom has a slow ring circling each one, the same ring on all six, because that ring is what made them beautiful in the first place — and when a rebuild lost it, the answer was to put the ring back, not to invent a new button. When you scroll, the bar slips away so it never interrupts your reading, and it comes back only when you have reached the bottom and are ready to go somewhere else. At the bottom of a note, one row holds everything: ten gold stars in a circle, a heart that stays because love is a jewel, a comment box that unfolds below for the why. One treatment everywhere, judged by one eye — his — after it lands.
intelligence.simple_view: Nothing is done until Shawn has seen the whole thing done right! First we prove one beautiful thing — the agreement unfolding, all done right, right in front of him! Then we take that exact same shape and make every page from it! The day lives in one room, with everything inside it! Colors walk one rainbow road, in the same order, never doubled up! And the inspector checks every link, one by one, and fixes each one right away — no big list of broken things, just fixed things!
intelligence.grandma_view: Nothing may look flat, dear — not even a little bit! Every picture must be deep and real, like a shiny black jewel. The pretty emblem goes in every corner, tilted just so. One star means one point. The mail button is a big clean plus. And everything must be the very best — never just okay!
intelligence.naya_view: EVERYTHING GOES IN THE VAULT, ORGANIZED, ONE DOOR. ANY NAYA OPENS IT AND SEES THE WHOLE PROJECT. THE VAULT IS A THIN LAYER — IT ORGANIZES WHAT'S THERE, NEVER REBUILDS IT. NEW WORK LANDS IN THE VAULT FIRST.
